description: This file defines the 'SugarBean' base class in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing core functionalities for business objects such as creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, relationship management, and query building within the application framework. It also includes setup for custom fields, relationship metadata management, and complex list query processing.

classes.name: SugarBean
classes.description: The core base class for all data objects in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing fundamental data handling, relationship, querying, and metadata management functionalities.

methods.name: setupCustomFields
methods.description: Loads custom field definitions for the module, initializing dynamic fields.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a given interface, defaulting to false.

methods.name: populateDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default values for fields based on vardef definitions.

methods.name: parseDateDefault
methods.description: Creates date strings from default values like '+1 month', optionally including time.

methods.name: removeRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Removes cached relationship metadata for specified module and relationship key, clearing caches from both database and filesystem.

methods.name: createRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Populates relationship metadata for modules, creating relationship entries in the database based on vardefs.

methods.name: get_union_related_list
methods.description: Builds and executes union queries for related list views and subpanels, handling complex query union operations.

methods.name: build_sub_queries_for_union
methods.description: Constructs subqueries for each related panel, supporting custom data source functions, relationship loading, and field aggregation.

methods.name: process_union_list_query
methods.description: Applies pagination, executes union queries, retrieves data, and handles related objects for list views/subpanels.

methods.name: _get_num_rows_in_query
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows a given SQL query would produce, performing a count query.

methods.name: retrieve_parent_fields
methods.description: Retrieves parent record data for objects with relationship metadata, supporting one-to-many and many-to-many relations.

methods.name: getAuditEnabledFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Returns a list of fields with their definitions that have the audited property set to true, considering whether audit is enabled for the module.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Determines if the provided user_id is the owner of the bean, based on assignment or creation data.

methods.name: get_custom_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom table associated with the object, based on the main table name.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name for the implementing class, either from a property or from the global dictionary.

methods.name: getObjectName
methods.description: Returns the object name of the bean; defaults to table_name if object_name is not explicitly set.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Returns index definitions for the module's table as specified in the global dictionary.

methods.name: getPrimaryFieldDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of the primary key field, typically 'id', or the first field in field_defs.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field definition for a given field name, or false if not found.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a field, returning boolean interpretations for true/false.

methods.name: unPopulateDefaultValues
methods.description: Resets fields with default values back to null, typically after data initialization.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Handles clone operation, generally unsetting loaded relationships.

methods.name: load_relationships
methods.description: Loads all link relationships defined on the bean.

methods.name: get_linked_fields
methods.description: Returns all fields that are of type 'link', i.e., relationship links.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Provides the full field definitions array for the object.

methods.name: load_relationship
methods.description: Loads a specific relationship by name, establishing a link object or relationship class.

methods.name: get_linked_beans
methods.description: Retrieves related beans for a specified relationship, with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: get_import_required_fields
methods.description: Lists fields required for import based on their 'importable' property set to 'required'.

methods.name: get_importable_fields
methods.description: Lists all fields that are eligible for import, considering their 'importable' property.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Creates database tables for the module, if they do not already exist, including audit tables.

methods.name: getACLCategory
methods.description: Returns the ACL category string for the module, defaults to module directory name.

methods.name: is_AuditEnabled
methods.description: Checks if auditing is enabled for the current object/module.

methods.name: get_audit_table_name
methods.description: Returns the audit table name suffix for the object.

methods.name: create_audit_table
methods.description: Creates the audit table based on metadata definitions if auditing is enabled.

methods.name: drop_tables
methods.description: Drops the main, custom, and audit tables of the module if they exist.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles insert or update of the bean, integrating custom logic, relationship saving, and auditing.

methods.name: saveFields
methods.description: Saves only specific fields to an existing record, not handling creation.

methods.name: cleanBean
methods.description: Sanitizes string fields of the bean, including HTML purifying for 'html' types.

methods.name: fixUpFormatting
methods.description: Adjusts data formatting for date, time, number, boolean, and encrypted fields prior to save.

methods.name: encrpyt_before_save
methods.description: Encrypts and base64 encodes a field value before saving.

methods.name: getEncryptKey
methods.description: Retrieves the system encryption key for field encryption, caching it statically.

methods.name: _checkOptimisticLocking
methods.description: Performs optimistic locking checks before saving to prevent conflicting updates.

methods.name: has_been_modified_since
methods.description: Checks if the record has been modified after a given timestamp by a specific user.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns bean's fields as an associative array, with options for formatting keys and values.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves changes related to bean relationships, such as adding or deleting related records.

methods.name: set_relationship_info
methods.description: Determines relationship id and link name from request or bean properties.

methods.name: handle_preset_relationships
methods.description: Handles preset relationship fields, adding or removing links as necessary.

methods.name: handle_remaining_relate_fields
methods.description: Processes all relate fields with 'save' property, adding or removing relationship links.

methods.name: update_parent_relationships
methods.description: Keeps parent relationship fields in sync if their values change or if the bean is deleted.

methods.name: handle_request_relate
methods.description: Handles relationship update based on request parameters, establishing links with related records.

methods.name: call_custom_logic
methods.description: Executes custom logic hooks during save or other lifecycle events, based on custom scripts.

methods.name: track_view
methods.description: Records a view event for the current user and module.

methods.name: auditBean
methods.description: Performs auditing of the bean, recording changes if auditing is enabled.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a single record by ID, with options for encoding and filtering deleted records. It populates the bean's fields and relationship data after retrieval, and handles custom logic hooks.

methods.name: getCustomJoin
methods.description: Proxy method to obtain custom join and select clauses for dynamic custom fields.

methods.name: convertRow
methods.description: Converts a database row from raw format to the internal format, mainly handling date/time conversions.

methods.name: convertField
methods.description: Converts individual field values based on field definitions, including decryption when applicable.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Loads data from a database row into the bean's fields.

methods.name: populateCurrencyFields
methods.description: Populates currency-related fields if the currency ID is set to default (-99).

methods.name: check_date_relationships_load
methods.description: Processes date and time fields for display formatting, including special handling for encrypt and date/time types.

methods.name: decrypt_after_retrieve
methods.description: Decrypts and decodes encrypted field values using Blowfish encryption.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates auxiliary fields such as assigned user, creator, modifier, and parent name after record retrieval.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Fills in parent-related fields such as parent name, first name, last name, supporting relations and display formatting.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Fetches related fields' data by module and record ID, offers option to return as array, and populates bean properties.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Recursively loads relate-type fields to populate related data on the bean.

methods.name: fill_in_link_field
methods.description: Loads relationship link data to populate foreign key fields.

methods.name: get_related_fields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields of type 'relate' as defined in the field definitions.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Retrieves related bean lists via relationship links, supports ordering, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Fetches a full list of records possibly including deleted ones, optionally checking date formats.

methods.name: process_full_list_query
methods.description: Processes a list of fetched records from a query, converting each row, handling date processing, and calling lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: create_index
methods.description: Creates an index in the database based on provided query string.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a record as deleted or performs custom deletion logic, updates DB, clears relationships, and logs the action.

methods.name: mark_undeleted
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted record, updates DB, possibly restores files, and calls lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: restoreFiles
methods.description: Restores files from a deleted state back to the active directory.

methods.name: haveFiles
methods.description: Determines whether the bean has associated files or images based on field definitions.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of filenames associated with the bean.

methods.name: getFilesFields
methods.description: Returns field names that store file data, cached for performance.

methods.name: deleteFileDirectory
methods.description: Generates the directory path for associated files based on the bean's ID.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Deletes all relationships linked to the bean by calling delete_linked.

methods.name: delete_linked
methods.description: Deletes all link relationships associated with the bean.

methods.name: deleteFiles
methods.description: Moves associated files to a deleted folder and records the deletion in a database table.

methods.name: build_related_list
methods.description: Builds a list of related records using a query and template object, with pagination support.

methods.name: build_related_list_where
methods.description: Builds a filtered list of related records with complex where and in clause support, including custom join logic.

methods.name: build_related_in
methods.description: Constructs an IN clause list for related record IDs from a query.

methods.name: build_related_list2
methods.description: Similar to build_related_list but populates specified fields directly from query results.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to add custom sections to list view.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns data prepared for list view (by default calls get_list_view_array).

methods.name: get_list_view_array
methods.description: Prepares an array of bean fields suitable for list view, handling sensitive and hidden fields, plus lookup display values.

methods.name: retrieve_by_string_fields
methods.description: Fetches a record based on string field matches, applying optional encoding and custom join clauses.

methods.name: get_where
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause string from a list of field-value pairs, with optional deleted filter.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Sets bean properties from an associative array.

methods.name: process_special_fields
methods.description: Executes custom functions on special fields prior to save during import.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Abstract method meant for subclasses to implement search filtering logic.

methods.name: parse_additional_headers
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to parse additional list view headers.

methods.name: assign_display_fields
methods.description: Assigns display values for fields, including date and enum options, based on module context.

methods.name: set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or updates relationships in custom link tables, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships
methods.description: Fetches list of related record IDs from a relationship table.

methods.name: loadLayoutDefs
methods.description: Loads and assigns layout definitions for the module from layout_def.php files.

methods.name: getRealKeyFromCustomFieldAssignedKey
methods.description: Determines the actual database field name for a custom dropdown based on extended info.

methods.name: getOwnerField
methods.description: Returns the owner (assignee or creator) field name or value.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides simple ACL-based display helper for list view links.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing, editing, deleting, export, or import, incorporating custom logic and group permissions.

methods.name: loadFromRow
methods.description: Loads data from an array into the bean, then runs date processing and custom logic hooks.

methods.name: create_qualified_order_by
methods.description: Qualifies column names in order by clauses with table prefixes for support across DBMS.

methods.name: add_address_streets
methods.description: Concatenates address street fields into a main address field for display.

methods.name: populateRelatedBean
methods.description: Hook to populate a related bean during import, overridable.

methods.name: beforeImportSave
methods.description: Hook called before saving during import.

methods.name: afterImportSave
methods.description: Hook called after saving during import.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query for module export, customizable in subclasses.

methods.name: auditBean
methods.description: Performs audit recording if auditing is enabled, on record update.

methods.name: createAuditRecord
methods.description: Creates audit entries based on data changes, and resets fetched row to prevent duplication.
